headline: G7 agree up to 100M barrels of diesel and crude to ease fuel prices; Chancellery walk-back on Zuckersteuer “stop”; Anthropic launches $100M Claude Frontier Academy.

stories.title: G7: up to 100M barrels of diesel and crude
facts: G7 agreed a coordinated IEA release of up to 100 million barrels of diesel and crude over four months, starting immediately (tagesschau ~18:07 Berlin).
Front-loaded: a “substantial” diesel release in the first 20 days by G7 members and partners.
Merz joined the G7 video call (France chairs); Macron said all participants — including Trump — committed to no export bans among themselves.
Earlier Friday, deputy spokesperson Hille had urged calm after US pressure/Trump diesel-export threats: don’t unsettle markets; US still a reliable fuel partner; no new IEA request known then.
stories.whyItMatters: Evening flip from Berlin caution to a G7 deal — the first big coordinated fuel-reserve move since the March 400M-barrel IEA release after the Iran war.

stories.title: Zuckersteuer: Chancellery says it did not “stop” the bill
facts: Deputy spokesperson Hille (Fri): Chancellery did not stop the BMF draft — inter-ministry talks are “as usual”; ministries are “in good talks,” confident of a deal.
Klingbeil still expects a quick agreement; CSU Ag minister Rainer’s shop: coalition agrees the tax will come — details still being aligned.
Still disputed: revenue size. Commission path ~€400M+/yr vs BMF planning ≥€650M in H2’27 and ~€1.2B from 2028 — numbers matter for the 2027 federal budget.
Material update vs afternoon lead that framed a hard Chancellery brake.
stories.whyItMatters: Walks back the “gestoppt” framing without resolving the rate/revenue fight — coalition optics still fragile into next week’s committee talks.

stories.title: Anthropic: Claude Frontier Academy — $100M, 10k engineers
facts: Anthropic launches Claude Frontier Academy with a $100M commitment to train 10,000 Frontier Deployed Engineers by end-2027.
First program: FDE Residency — multi-day in-person + simulated enterprise deploy + graded practical, then 12 weeks leading a real Claude use case; first credentials expected early 2027.
Opening cohorts (SF/NY/London) include Accenture, Bain, Capgemini, Commonwealth Bank of Australia, Deloitte, McKinsey, Morgan Stanley, Novo Nordisk.
Nomination-only via Anthropic account/partner teams — aims to close the enterprise AI deployment talent gap.
stories.whyItMatters: Major vendor talent play — Anthropic training customer/partner engineers to its own FDE bar, not just shipping another model card.
